title: Minimum Number of Days to Make m Bouquets
goal: Find the earliest day that supplies m disjoint bouquets of k adjacent flowers.
strategy: For one candidate day, consecutive bloomed flowers form disjoint greedy groups. Feasibility only improves with time, allowing a binary search on days.
